vb_textbox.text: I didnt find a pattern myself, neither did the person before me who gave me advice. As you dont know what the other gnome's mushroom totals are in each round, its impossible to tell if you picked the right gnome or not. I tried analysing colour, hat shape, height of each gnome and background differences. I can say I saw no difference in backgrounds. At one point, the short gnome with the flatter rounded cap seemed to do well, but it didnt last. Brown gnomes with tall hats didnt do well, but that also changed later in the game. I tried picking taller gnomes vs. shorter ones and that didnt seem to work and vice versa. Ultimately, I feel it is random.
